captions.instagram:
How does the endocrine system work?

Nine small glands, from a pea under your brain to the islets in your pancreas, run your body by sending chemical messages in the blood. Watch only the cells with the right lock respond, kick a hormone and see negative feedback pull it back, race a nerve against a hormone, and grow a baby into an adult.

→ Your endocrine system is a set of small glands that send chemical messages through your blood.
→ From the brain to the belly: pituitary, thyroid, adrenals, pancreas islets, ovaries or testes.
→ A hormone reaches every cell, but only cells with the right receptor respond, like a key and its lock.
→ Adrenaline fits the heart and liver: nerves take milliseconds, hormones seconds to days.
→ The hypothalamus tells the pituitary, and the pituitary tells the thyroid: a chain of command.

youtubeLong.title: How does the endocrine system work? (interactive explainer)
youtubeLong.description:
Nine small glands, from a pea under your brain to the islets in your pancreas, run your body by sending chemical messages in the blood. Watch only the cells with the right lock respond, kick a hormone and see negative feedback pull it back, race a nerve against a hormone, and grow a baby into an adult.

▶ Play with the interactive version: https://glassbox-production-fd52.up.railway.app/e/endocrineclear/
⌘ Source code (MIT): https://github.com/bdeeps/endocrineclear

In this video:
• Glands with no tubes. The hypothalamus, pituitary, pineal, thyroid, parathyroids, thymus, adrenals, pancreatic islets and ovaries or testes make more than 50 hormones.
• A key for the right lock. Every cell meets every hormone, but only cells with the matching receptor respond.
• A thermostat in your head. The hypothalamus tells the pituitary, and the pituitary tells the thyroid or adrenals.
• Sugar and stress. After a meal insulin sends sugar into the liver and muscles; in a fast glucagon brings it back out, holding blood sugar near 70 to 100 mg/dL.
• Growing up. Growth hormone, released mostly in deep sleep, and thyroid hormone grow you; GnRH, LH and FSH start puberty.
• When hormones go wrong. About 101 million Indians have diabetes (ICMR-INDIAB, 2023) and about 1 in 10 adults has an underactive thyroid.
